title: Morphics Base Category (a node in the body-type tree)

id.description: A child id is its parent id plus one more segment.

parent.description: Parent base id. Absent on a root (top-level) base.

skeleton.description: Unreal asset path. Set on a root. Children inherit it.

required_animations.description: Set on a root. Children inherit it.

proportion_notes.description: Optional. How this subcategory differs from its parent (size, build).

animation_overrides.description: Animations this subcategory replaces. Every other animation is inherited from the parent. Names must be in the root's required_animations.

spectrum.description: Spectrum id: the soft currency for forms under this root. Set on roots only. Unique per root.
